claude.note: one tool-using turn (Read) under harness minimal, so no MCP servers, skills, settings or hooks: the home path in memory_paths.auto redacted to /Users/example and the scratch cwd to /tmp/konvoy-capture, fields konvoy never reads. An earlier inherit capture was discarded because it carried 24 of the user's home paths and 11KB of their own hook output

claude-partial.note: one tool-using turn (Read) under harness minimal with --include-partial-messages, the flag konvoy now sends: every text block arrives first as stream_event text_delta lines and is then repeated whole in the assistant message that closes it, which is the duplication the stateful parser exists to drop. Thinking is redacted to empty blocks (signatures replaced), the scratch cwd redacted to /tmp/konvoy-capture, and the tool input's split path rejoined, redacted and re-split into the same number of deltas

claude-thinking.note: NOT re-captured with the others, and deliberately so: the API redacts thinking blocks unless showThinkingSummaries is set, and harness minimal strips the settings files that could set it - a minimal capture on 2.1.280 produced no thinking block at all. This one is the only evidence konvoy has that the thinking branch is real, so it stays until a capture under inherit can be redacted safely

claude-error.note: resume of a nonexistent id: exit 1, result subtype error_during_execution with is_error true and no result text; the wording ("No conversation found with session ID") is on stderr, which is what src/core/session.ts STALE matches against

codex.note: one tool-using turn (command_execution, start and completed with exit_code 0) captured at permission auto, which is what makes a headless codex tool call possible: at `edit` the sandbox blocks the command and codex answers "the shell command was blocked". Carries no skills-budget notice, since --ignore-user-config leaves no skills to shorten - codex-rate.jsonl holds that path

codex-rate.note: a real exhausted-quota refusal, recorded during a smoke run and costing no quota: the skills-budget notice arrives as an error ITEM, then the failure arrives twice, as a top-level error line and inside turn.failed. Design §33 had this as uncapturable because a rate limit cannot be forced

kiro.note: one tool-using turn (fs_read, titled "Reading package.json:1") under harness minimal, so through a generated konvoy-minimal agent profile. The model read the file but disputed its name, so the answer is a sentence rather than a bare version - the stream shape is what the fixture is for, and it reaches tool_call, tool_call_update, agent_message_chunk, metadata and runFinished

opencode.note: one tool-using turn (read); re-captured after the CLI moved from 2.0.10 during the audit

antigravity.note: a real first turn through agy: init carries the conversation_id konvoy binds to, the answer arrives as agent_response text deltas, and result carries the final text plus usage. Home and scratch paths redacted

antigravity-resumed.note: the same conversation resumed with --conversation <id>, which returned the nonce stored in the first turn: the live proof that an antigravity binding carries its context. num_turns 2 and the usage is cumulative for the conversation

antigravity-tool.note: a tool step under --mode plan: step_type is "tool" with its arguments under tool_info.parameters, and the call is auto-denied because a headless turn cannot be prompted, leaving status SUCCESS with an empty response. The reason is only on stderr, which Adapter.warnings reads

antigravity-missing.note: a resume of a conversation id that does not exist: agy warns on stderr and silently starts a NEW conversation, exit 0, so the init event reports a different id than the one asked for. Also carries denied_actions in the result
